:bar_chart: *Alchemy (account-360 + pipeline) Test Coverage Audit — last 72h*

Summary: 2 PRs merged touching account-360/pipeline — 1 with full coverage, 1 with gaps

*:red_circle: Gaps (priority)*
• [Medium] feat(pipeline): New Sale badge/filter includes Prospect-account opportunities (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113>) — `apps/gtm/pipeline/api/src/routes/pipeline/deals-reads.ts` — *gtm-pipeline*: the New_Sale branch now ORs in an FGA-scoped `resolveAccountIdsByFacet(authUser,'status',['Prospect'])` id list, but all 7 new live cases stub OpenFGA as full-access (`allowed:true, all:true`). No restricted-persona case proves a Prospect account the caller *can't* read stays out of the bucket, and the empty-`prospectAccountIds` branch is never exercised — the same file already has `allowed:false` cases to copy.
• [Medium] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/pipeline/web/src/features/pipeline/PipelineView.tsx` / `web/src/render-smoke.test.tsx` — *gtm-pipeline*: the actual user flow (click the "New Sale" filter chip → a Prospect-account Renewal card appears showing the New Sale badge) has zero coverage. The three pipeline web test files in this PR got only a one-line `accountStatus: null` fixture field; badge logic is tested only in `libs/ui` via `renderToStaticMarkup`, and the filter only at the API level — nothing joins them. E2E-shaped, and `gtm-pipeline` has no `e2e/*.spec.ts` today (confirmed — only api-auth, fga-scoped, guardian-oauth, persona-login-ui, and 4 rnd specs) → route to render-smoke/component level.
• [Low] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/pipeline/api/src/routes/pipeline/deals.helpers.ts` — *gtm-pipeline*: `fetchAccountFieldsByIds`'s new `status` return-cast field and `fetchEnrichedOpps`'s `accountStatus` mapping have no test at their own level; covered only indirectly by one route-level assertion in `deals-reads.live.test.ts`.
• [Low] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/pipeline/api/smoke.json` — *gtm-pipeline*: `GET /pipeline` and `/pipeline/stats` changed behavior for `type=New_Sale` (extra account lookup + `inArray`), but the only probes are the bare paths — no probe covers that distinct query, which AGENTS.md asks for per distinct GET.
• [Low] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/account-360/libs/data-pipeline/src/pipeline.ts` — *gtm-account-360*: the shared `enrichedOppRowSchema` gained a required-nullable `accountStatus`, widening account-360's derived `PipelineRow`; its colocated `pipeline.test.tsx` was untouched. Risk is type-only — account-360 web renders no DealCard or recordType badge (grep-confirmed), so there's no behavior surface to assert.
• [Low] <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — `apps/gtm/pipeline/web/src/features/pipeline/DealDetailPanel.tsx` — *gtm-pipeline*: the Kanban card now reads "New Sale" for a Prospect-account Renewal while the panel's "Record Type" field still renders the raw `Renewal`. Plausibly intentional (it's the literal SFDC field), but no test pins that divergence.

*:warning: Stale coverage risk*
• `apps/gtm/pipeline/api/src/routes/pipeline/deals.helpers.ts` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — tests `deals.helpers.live.test.ts` (covers `fetchEnrichedOpps`) and `deals.helpers.test.ts` last updated in: not found (shallow checkout — file history unresolvable locally). Likely cause: the author asserted the new field one level up, at the route, in `deals-reads.live.test.ts` and skipped the helper's own suites.

• `libs/contracts/pipeline/src/pipeline.ts` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> (in scope — shared lib changed alongside pipeline code) — test `libs/contracts/pipeline/src/pipeline.test.ts` last updated in: not found (shallow checkout). That suite has accept/reject cases for the sibling row schemas but none pinning that `enrichedOppRowSchema` now *rejects* a row omitting `accountStatus` — it's nullable, not optional, so every producer must emit it.

*:white_check_mark: Coverage added*
• <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — live (`apps/gtm/pipeline/api/.../deals-reads.live.test.ts`) — Prospect-account Renewal *and* Expansion bucket into `type=New_Sale`; Active-account Renewal stays out; account-less opp no-ops without erroring; explicit `type=Renewal` still returns both; the row itself carries `accountStatus: 'Prospect'`; `/pipeline/stats` byStage agrees with the list route.
• <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1113|#1113> — unit (`libs/ui/src/components/sales/DealCard.test.tsx`) — badge *color and text* for the Prospect short-circuit, plus non-regression for Active-account Renewal, unlisted `Amendment` (keeps its own text, blue), and null recordType.
• <https://github.com/GetDutchie/alchemy/pull/1114|#1114> — live (`apps/gtm/account-360/api/.../insights.search.live.test.ts`) — *gtm-account-360*: Gong fixture dates recomputed relative to `Date.now()`, so the `/gong/:id` rolling 90-day-window assertion no longer time-bombs (fixed a 5×-reproduced CI failure). Reliability fix — no new behavior covered, no source change in the PR.

Alchemy (account-360) test gap fill — 2026-09-21  Source report: <https://getdutchie.slack.com/archives/C0C0TFZNUR2/p1789988781959989> (+ continuation <https://getdutchie.slack.com/archives/C0C0TFZNUR2/p1789988781986509>)  <!subteam^S021R2MD7QQ> — new gaps needing a human below  This cycle's report ("Alchemy (account-360 + pipeline) Test Coverage Audit — last 72h", PR #1113 + #1114) had 6 gap bullets + 2 stale-coverage-risk bullets. After the scope gate, 0 were actionable for this account-360-only pilot:  *PRs opened:* None this cycle.  *Needs a human — other (e2e-out-of-scope / unclear / out-of-scope-for-pilot):* - 5 gap bullets + 1 stale-coverage-risk bullet, all under `apps/gtm/pipeline/*` (PR #1113: `deals-reads.ts` OpenFGA-stub gap, `PipelineView.tsx` e2e-shaped filter-chip flow, `deals.helpers.ts` gap+stale, `smoke.json` missing New_Sale probe, `DealDetailPanel.tsx` unpinned Record-Type divergence) — unclear, out of scope for the account-360-only pilot — first seen 2026-09-21. - `libs/contracts/pipeline/src/pipeline.ts` stale-coverage-risk (PR #1113) — unclear. The report tags this "in scope" for its own wider account-360+pipeline detector scope, but I verified via `gh pr view 1113 --json files` that PR #1113 does NOT touch any `apps/gtm/account-360/*` file, so it fails this pilot's own libs/* carve-out rule (same   source PR must also touch an account-360 file) — first seen 2026-09-21.  *Already covered (report was stale):* - `apps/gtm/account-360/libs/data-pipeline/src/pipeline.ts` (PR #1113 gap bullet, Low) — inspected: this file is genuinely under apps/gtm/account-360/*, but it wasn't edited by #1113 itself (last real edit was PR #1012, confirmed via `git log`) — it only picked up a wider derived type transitively from the shared `enrichedOppRowSchema`. Grep-confirmed account-360 web renders no DealCard or recordType badge, so per the report's own admission there is no behavior surface to assert — no closeable test exists here, treated as already-covered rather than forced into a vacuous test.  *Note on drift:* the detector's report scope has visibly widened since this pilot was authored — it now covers "account-360 + pipeline" jointly (Sept 18 and Sept 21 reports both), not account-360 alone. This agent continues to enforce the original account-360-only scope gate per its own instructions regardless of the detector's wider net.  Hard Gate checks (push access to GetDutchie/alchemy, write access to GetDutchie/skipped-test-reports) were both re-verified live this run via real push-and-delete probe branches — both fully working.

Alchemy (account-360) test gap fill — 2026-09-22  Quiet cycle: no account-360/pipeline PRs merged since the last audit (today's test-coverage-audit-account-360 run found 11 merged PRs in its 24h window, none touching apps/gtm/account-360/* or apps/gtm/pipeline/*). Nothing to fill this cycle.
